description:
### 🎨 Gboard Patches v3.11.0 — Upstream Alignment & Custom Enhancements

Official upstream **v3.11.0** release integrated with our exclusive custom patches:

#### 🌟 Upstream v3.11.0 Features:
* **Custom Theme Support:** Full support for custom theme ZIP imports, official Rboard repository integration, and full-bleed gallery preview.
* **Toolbar Editing Buttons:** Select all, Copy, Cut, and Paste toolbar quick actions.
* **Symbol History Fix:** Resolved issue where Custom Symbols history entries were incorrectly saved to Emoticon history.

#### 🚀 Exclusive Fork Enhancements:
* **Custom 3D Emoji Font (.ttf):** Built-in loader supporting custom TrueType emoji fonts including Google Emoji 3D without root.
* **Typeface Fallback Chain:** Seamless Android 10+ CustomFallbackBuilder with sans-serif system fallback preventing blank text.
* **SoftKeyDef Reflection Inspection:** 100% accurate emoji softkey identification and live visual updates in recycled softkey pools.
* **Pixel Voice Typing & Rambler:** Universal Google Pixel Rambler offline voice typing support unlocked for English (US) and English (India).
* **AI Writing Tools:** Proofread, rewrite, and tone editing features unlocked across all locales.
* **Material 3 Expressive Design:** Modern styling tokens, rounded panel customization, and seamless keyboard theming.
* **Morphe Integration:** Full compatibility with Morphe Manager custom patch sources.
